package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"net/http"
)

type NextActionGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentNextAction, error)
}

func (h StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetNextAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	id, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || h.NextAction == nil {
		http.Error(w, "next action unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.NextAction.Handle(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		writeDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}
